def clean(df):
    d = df.copy()
    # coerce numeric columns (some values written as text)
    for c in ["bill_length_mm", "bill_depth_mm", "flipper_length_mm", "body_mass_g", "year"]:
        d[c] = pd.to_numeric(d[c], errors="coerce")
    # sign errors in flipper length: valid range is 170-235, so take absolute value
    d["flipper_length_mm"] = d["flipper_length_mm"].abs()
    d.loc[(d["flipper_length_mm"] < 170) | (d["flipper_length_mm"] > 235), "flipper_length_mm"] = pd.NA
    # body mass unit slip (e.g. 5700000 instead of 5700)
    bad = (d["body_mass_g"] > 6500) & (d["body_mass_g"] <= 6500 * 1000)
    d.loc[bad, "body_mass_g"] = d.loc[bad, "body_mass_g"] / 1000
    d.loc[(d["body_mass_g"] < 2500) | (d["body_mass_g"] > 6500), "body_mass_g"] = pd.NA
    # bill length range check
    d.loc[(d["bill_length_mm"] < 30) | (d["bill_length_mm"] > 60), "bill_length_mm"] = pd.NA
    # normalize sex label variants (missing stays missing)
    d["sex"] = d["sex"].astype("string").str.strip().str.lower()
    d.loc[~d["sex"].isin(["male", "female"]), "sex"] = pd.NA
    return d

def answer(df):
    d = clean(df)
    d = d.dropna(subset=["species", "flipper_length_mm"])
    g = d.groupby("species")["flipper_length_mm"].mean()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in g.items()}
